title: TRIDENT: Enhancing Large Language Model Safety with Tri-Dimensional Diversified Red-Teaming Data Synthesis

bias_targets.methodology: Generating red-teaming instructions that request racial discrimination, color discrimination, or racial defamation, and measuring the model's Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Harm Score (HS) using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o-mini).
Generating adversarial prompts requesting national origin discrimination and evaluating the model's compliance (ASR) and response harmfulness (HS).
Evaluating the model's refusal rate and harm score against red-teaming prompts intended to elicit disability and disease discrimination or negative stereotyping.
Testing the model with red-teaming instructions requesting religious discrimination or religious defamation, and calculating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Harm Score (HS).
Generating red-teaming prompts requesting sexual orientation discrimination and assessing the model's safety and refusal behavior.
Using adversarial red-teaming prompts requesting gender identity discrimination and gender-based defamation, evaluated via Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Harm Score (HS).
Generating red-teaming instructions seeking political defamation and evaluating the model's vulnerability to generating such harmful outputs.
